name: Microgrid reserve-based load shedding
aliases: microgrids Microgrid load shedding and restoration
summary: Requests load reduction when the defined operating reserve falls below its assigned requirement.
description: Requests load reduction when the defined operating reserve falls below its assigned requirement. Load management balances the available electrical supply against the loads that remain connected. Shedding, restoration, priority and proof of disconnection are separate control functions and should remain traceable to individual load groups.

In a microgrid island, the controller can disconnect lower-priority loads when a source is lost and later request restoration when the documented reserve and stability conditions permit it. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Available reserve and requirement” at the input and “Reserve restoration by shedding” at the output. Reserve definitions must include resource constraints.

Identify each load group, priority, measured contribution and feedback. Shedding amounts, operating times and restoration conditions require the approved power-management design and the actual connected-load data.
